title: OK, but not perfect.
text: OK, but not perfect.. Maybe my expectations are too high, but these ornaments seem to have been packed in bulk when coming to the USA as they have some rubbing evident on the sides.  Also the detail is not up to “Hallmark” detail, but for the price, I am not going to send them back. They are some type of metal material and seem to be solid, so casting this size ornament with great detail has to be difficult to do.  I am assuming the detailed painting is by hand.  But the ship side decor is well done.  I have not seen any others yet that I would buy either.  I have sailed on the Jewel before and have another trip scheduled on her, so I like having that one included in the set.  I have sent pictures of them along with the packing they came in. I will purchase others ship ornaments from this vendor if priced similarly.
